verdicts.reason: A: the peach circle is cut loose from the can and now sits behind the FREE DELIVERY/4 FLAVOURS badges in the top-left. The badges come first in the reading order, ahead of the headline, which falls to the bottom half. The left-aligned text clashes with the centred can and centred CTA, there are big dead gaps between the blocks, and the legal line is tiny. B: the headline leads the reading order and the badges sit with the CTA, but the headline runs across the detached circle. The left edges are ragged (headline ~54px, badges ~74px, CTA ~96px), the can floats on the right away from the copy, and the bottom third is empty apart from microscopic legal text. B is slightly less broken because its reading order is right.
